heading.zh-Hant: 軍旅歷程與當選將軍
heading.en: Military career and election as General

body.zh-Hant: 吉桑1874年10月21日生於沃州梅濟耶爾，1960年4月7日卒於普利。他1894年成為砲兵少尉，1904年升上尉；1908年任總參謀部上尉，1911年升少校，並應總參謀長之請轉入步兵。1919年他任第2師參謀長，同時兼步兵第9團團長。1932年起他指揮德語區的第2軍，其後轉任法語區的第1軍。1939年8月30日，聯邦議會以231票中的204票選他為將軍。
body.en: Henri Guisan was born in Mézières (VD) on 21 October 1874 and died in Pully on 7 April 1960. He became a lieutenant of field artillery in 1894 and a captain in 1904; in 1908 he was a captain on the General Staff and in 1911 a major, moving to the infantry at the request of the Chief of the General Staff. In 1919 he was chief of staff of the 2nd Division and also commanded Infantry Regiment 9. From 1932 he led the German-speaking 2nd Army Corps and then the French-speaking 1st Corps. On 30 August 1939 the Federal Assembly elected him General by 204 of 231 votes.

heading.zh-Hant: 1940年起的阿爾卑斯堡壘部署
heading.en: The Alpine Réduit deployment from 1940

body.zh-Hant: 1940年6月初，德軍西線得勝、法國崩潰，吉桑把利馬特防線自巴塞爾延伸到日內瓦。他後來採折衷方案：五個（後來六個）師與三個山地旅進駐阿爾卑斯堡壘（Réduit）。重整於7月25日完成，同日他在呂特利召集少校以上的部隊指揮官，說明軍隊退入堡壘，並呼籲軍民無條件抵抗。1941年5月，他再把汝拉與中部高原的三個師撤入堡壘；1944年6月盟軍在諾曼第登陸後，他又把部隊自堡壘調回中部高原。歷史辭典指出，堡壘構想並非出自他。
body.en: In early June 1940, after the German successes in the western campaign and the collapse of France, Guisan extended the Limmat position from Basel to Geneva. He later chose a middle course, placing five (later six) divisions and three mountain brigades in the Alpine Réduit. The regrouping was completed on 25 July, the day of the Rütli Report, when he called all troop commanders of major rank and above together to tell them of the withdrawal into the Réduit and called on people and army to resist without condition. In May 1941 he also took three divisions in the Jura and Mittelland back into the Réduit; after the Allied landing in Normandy in June 1944 he moved troops from the Réduit back to the Mittelland. The HLS notes that the Réduit concept did not originate with him.

heading.zh-Hant: 指揮風格與卸任
heading.en: Style of command and discharge

body.zh-Hant: 歷史辭典評他不是大戰略家，但懂得聽取建議、做決定並承擔風險。1936年起與法國的參謀會談，他走到中立國所能允許的極限；1940年5月初，他下令調查124名被懷疑有前線主義或納粹同情的軍官。1945年8月20日，他以將軍身分卸任。
body.en: The HLS judges that Guisan was no great strategist, but he knew how to listen to advice, make decisions and take risks. In the staff talks with the French begun in 1936 he went to the limits of what was possible for a neutral state; in early May 1940 he ordered an investigation of 124 officers suspected of Frontist or National Socialist sympathies. He was discharged as General on 20 August 1945, at the end of active service.

heading.zh-Hant: 學運、自由集團與南機關
heading.en: Student strike, Freedom Bloc and the Minami Kikan

body.zh-Hant: 昂山生於1915年。就讀仰光大學期間，他於1936年與學生同盟議長吳努一同領導學生罷課，畢業後加入德欽黨從事政治活動。1939年德欽黨與巴莫等人合組反英統一戰線「自由集團」，昂山被選為書記長，但為避免被捕而秘密出走中國廈門。同年11月，他在參謀本部鈴木敬司大佐的引導下抵達日本，並參加負責對緬謀略的「南機關」；1941年他與被送出緬甸的三十名緬甸青年在海南島接受軍事訓練，同年年底組成「緬甸獨立義勇軍」，並與日軍並行進攻緬甸。
body.en: Aung San was born in 1915. At Rangoon University he led a student strike in 1936 with the student union chairman U Nu, then joined the Thakin party. When the Thakins and Ba Maw formed the anti-British Freedom Bloc in 1939 he was elected secretary-general, but slipped out to Amoy in China to avoid arrest. In November 1939 he reached Japan through Colonel Suzuki Keiji of the General Staff and joined the Minami Kikan; in 1941 he and thirty Burmese youths smuggled out of Burma trained on Hainan Island, and at the end of that year formed the Burma Independence Army, which invaded Burma alongside the Japanese army.

heading.zh-Hant: 學生民族主義者與日本訓練
heading.en: Student nationalist and Japanese training

body.zh-Hant: 昂山1932年進入仰光大學，成為學生領袖，也參與民族主義運動「我們緬人協會」，使用「德欽」稱號。1940年他與一名同伴秘密前往東京，與日本陸軍接觸；他與三十名同志接受日軍訓練，並參與1942年入侵緬甸的戰役，英軍在混亂中退往印度。他當時任緬甸獨立軍（BIA）的少將兼參謀長；該軍在1942年中被日方解散。
body.en: Aung San entered Rangoon University in 1932 and became a student leader, also active in the nationalist movement Dobama Asiayone, whose leaders used the title thakin. In 1940 he and a companion travelled secretly to Tokyo and made contact with the Japanese army; he and thirty comrades were trained by the Japanese army and took part in the 1942 invasion of Burma, in which the British army was driven out in a chaotic retreat to India. He was a major general and chief of staff of the Burma Independence Army (BIA); the Japanese disbanded the BIA in mid-1942.

heading.zh-Hant: 緬甸防衛軍與國防部長
heading.en: Burma Defence Army and Minister for Defence

body.zh-Hant: 1942年7月，日方從緬甸獨立軍挑出約三千人組成緬甸防衛軍（BDA），由昂山指揮。1943年9月緬甸由日本給予「獨立」，昂山出任國防部長，軍隊改稱緬甸國民軍，改由奈溫統率。該政府實為由巴莫領導的傀儡政府，昂山與其他德欽感到受騙。
body.en: In July 1942 the Japanese selected some 3,000 BIA men to form the Burma Defence Army (BDA), and Aung San was placed in command. When Burma received its 'independence' from the Japanese in September 1943, he was made Minister for Defence and the army was renamed the Burma National Army under Ne Win. The government was in fact a puppet government led by Ba Maw, and Aung San and the other thakins felt cheated.

heading.zh-Hant: 反法西斯同盟、倒戈與遇刺
heading.en: Anti-Fascist League, the 1945 turn and assassination

body.zh-Hant: 昂山自1944年起領導一個秘密的全國反法西斯聯盟，該聯盟1945年定名為反法西斯人民自由同盟（AFPFL）。3月27日他率緬甸國民軍開出仰光前往彬馬那，假稱演習，實際與英軍斯利姆將軍的部隊接觸，轉向協助盟軍，投入對日作戰的戰役。1947年他在倫敦簽署獨立協議；1947年7月19日武裝人員闖入政府會議，將他殺害。
body.en: From 1944 Aung San led a secret national anti-fascist coalition, which was named the Anti-Fascist People's Freedom League (AFPFL) in 1945. On 27 March he marched the Burma National Army out of Rangoon to Pyinmana, pretending to go on exercise, but made contact with General Slim's forces and turned to help the Allies against the Japanese. In 1947 he signed an independence agreement in London; on 19 July 1947 armed men burst into a government meeting and killed him.

heading.zh-Hant: 總督行政會議副主席與遇刺
heading.en: Deputy Chairman of the Executive Council and assassination

body.zh-Hant: 1946年9月26日，總督宣布改組行政會議，使其涵蓋各政黨；英國下議院的書面答覆稱，反法西斯人民自由同盟主席吳昂山出任新行政會議副主席，並兼任總督的國防與外交顧問。美國駐仰光總領事則回報，這是不管部的行政會議成員兼副主席職位，「這個職位給了昂山」。1947年2月他與撣、克欽、欽各族代表簽署協議（平龍會議）；同月美國領事評估英方已選定他作為緬甸近期的領導人。7月他與其他六名閣員遭政敵吳素的手下暗殺；英國首相艾德禮在下議院稱他展現了高度的領導素質，是緬甸在關鍵時刻難以失去的人物。
body.en: On 26 September 1946 the Governor re-formed the Executive Council to represent the parties; a Commons written answer says U Aung San, President of the AFPFL, became its Deputy Chairman and the Governor's Counsellor for Defence and External Affairs. The US Consul General at Rangoon reported it as a Council member without portfolio and Deputy Chairman, a position "given Aung San". In February 1947 he signed an agreement with Shan, Kachin and Chin representatives (Panglong), and the US consul judged that the British had picked him for Burma's near future. In July he and six other ministers were assassinated by men of his rival U Saw; Prime Minister Attlee told the Commons he had shown high qualities of leadership and could ill be spared.

heading.zh-Hant: 醫師出身與投身印度獨立聯盟
heading.en: Physician and the Indian Independence League

body.zh-Hant: 克希米·薩迦爾（本名拉克希米·斯瓦米納坦，1914至2012年）1938年取得醫學學位，1940年前往新加坡。日本占領期間，她參與印度獨立聯盟。1943年，鮑斯抵達新加坡接掌印度國民軍，她身為著名的女性活動者，是機場迎接委員會的成員之一。
body.en: Lakshmi Sahgal (born Lakshmi Swaminathan; 1914–2012) obtained her medical degree in 1938 and went to Singapore in 1940. During the Japanese Occupation she became involved with the Indian Independence League. In 1943, when Subhas Chandra Bose arrived in Singapore to take command of the INA, she was, as a prominent woman activist, part of the official reception committee that met him at the airport.

heading.zh-Hant: 女子聯隊「占西女王聯隊」指揮官
heading.en: Commander of the Rani of Jhansi Regiment

body.zh-Hant: 占西女王聯隊於1943年7月12日成立，鮑斯以那位傳奇的占西女王命名。應鮑斯之請，她接掌該聯隊的指揮，設立營地並招募年輕女性入伍，人稱「拉克希米上尉」。聯隊的新加坡營地於1943年10月22日在滑鐵盧街開幕。她同時成為臨時政府的閣員，掌管婦女事務。聯隊始終未被派往前線。
body.en: The new Rani of Jhansi Regiment was formed on 12 July 1943 and Bose named it after the legendary Rani of Jhansi. At Bose's request she took up its command, establishing a camp and recruiting young women, and became known as Captain Lakshmi. The Rani of Jhansi camp at Waterloo Street, Singapore, was opened on 22 October 1943. She was also included in the cabinet of the provisional government, as minister for women's affairs. The regiment was never sent to the frontlines.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰敗、被俘與戰後
heading.en: Capture and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 1945年戰爭結束時，她被游擊隊俘虜，被迫徒步穿越叢林數日。1946年她在仰光被交給英國人，之後被送返印度並獲釋。1947年她與前印度國民軍軍官普雷姆·庫馬爾·薩迦爾結婚。在緬甸期間，她曾設立更多營地並辦理救濟工作。
body.en: When the war ended in 1945, Sahgal was taken prisoner by guerrilla fighters and made to march through the jungle for days. In 1946 she was handed over to the British in Rangoon, and subsequently repatriated to India and released. In 1947 she married Prem Kumar Sahgal, a former officer of the INA. Earlier, in Burma, she had established more camps and organised relief work.

heading.zh-Hant: 緬甸作戰期間的占西女王聯隊
heading.en: The Rani of Jhansi Regiment during the Burma campaign

body.zh-Hant: 據《Open》雜誌書評，占西女王聯隊最引人注目之處，在於其聰慧而有魅力的隊長拉克希米・斯瓦米納坦（即後來的拉克希米・薩迦爾醫生）。聯隊的女兵受訓約兩年，雖然被描述為並未實際投入作戰，但在仰光期間仍經歷長途夜行軍與叢林跋涉等嚴苛訓練。來源寫明該聯隊於1945年8月15日正式解散，距鮑斯逝世僅三天；其間部分人員早在數月前已陸續被遣返。來源未寫她個人參與的具體戰役或日期，因此本段僅記述聯隊在緬甸作戰期間的處境。
body.en: According to a review in Open magazine, the Rani of Jhansi Regiment was given interest chiefly because of its charismatic Captain Lakshmi Swaminathan, later Dr Lakshmi Sahgal. The Ranis trained as soldiers for two years; although they did not go to war, their time in Rangoon in particular included long-distance night marches and jungle treks. The regiment was formally disbanded on 15 August 1945, three days before Bose's death, although groups had been sent home at various points for some months. The source gives no specific battle or date for her personal participation, so this paragraph records only the regiment's situation during the Burma campaign.

heading.zh-Hant: 印度國民軍與他的職務
heading.en: The INA and his role

body.zh-Hant: 印度國民軍於1942年由在新加坡被日軍俘虜的印度戰俘組成。沙納瓦茲汗原屬第14旁遮普團，後來晉升為蘇巴斯聯隊（Subhas Regiment）的指揮官，之後擔任較高的參謀職務。他是穆斯林軍官。1944年印度國民軍與日軍一同突入印度，於英帕爾一帶推進。這些描述來自對該軍的概述；來源未標明他個人參戰的日期與地點。
body.en: The Indian National Army was formed in 1942 by Indian prisoners of war captured by the Japanese in Singapore. Shah Nawaz Khan, formerly of the 14th Punjab Regiment, rose to command the Subhas Regiment and later held a senior staff position. He was a Muslim officer. In 1944 the INA, working alongside the Japanese, broke into India near Imphal. These statements about the army are general; the sources do not give dates or places for his own participation.

heading.zh-Hant: 紅堡審判
heading.en: The Red Fort trial

body.zh-Hant: 1945年3月，他被控在緬甸波帕附近教唆殺害炮手穆罕默德·侯賽因。1945年11月，審判在德里紅堡開庭，由公開的軍事法庭審理。他與普雷姆·薩迦爾（印度教徒）、古爾巴赫什·辛格·迪隆（錫克教徒）一同受審。他依《印度刑法典》第121條被控向國王皇帝發動戰爭。
body.en: In March 1945, near Popa in Burma, he was accused of abetting the killing of Gunner Mohammad Hussain. The trial opened in November 1945 at the Red Fort in Delhi, before a public general court-martial. He was tried together with Prem Sahgal (a Hindu) and G. S. Dhillon (a Sikh). He was charged under Section 121 of the Indian Penal Code with waging war against the King-Emperor.

body.zh-Hant: 軍事法庭支持王室關於三人向國王皇帝發動戰爭的指控，但未確認他們個人須為所指控的殺人負刑責。1946年1月，總司令奧欽萊克赦免了終身流放的刑期，同時維持革職及沒收薪給的命令。三人隨後獲釋。
body.en: The Tribunal upheld the Crown's case that the three officers had waged war against the King-Emperor, but it did not establish their individual criminal liability for the alleged killings. body.zh-Hant: SCC Times 的文章寫道，印度國民軍在鮑斯與自由印度臨時政府之下重組為武裝力量，在緬甸戰役中與日軍並肩作戰，並企圖進入印度。沙納瓦茲汗原屬第14旁遮普團，後來晉升為蘇巴斯聯隊指揮官，之後擔任高級參謀職務。紅堡審判中，他被控依《印度刑法》第121條對國王皇帝發動戰爭，並另被控教唆殺害砲兵穆罕默德·侯賽因，地點為緬甸波帕附近，時間為1945年3月。以上為來源所載的指控內容；來源未寫他在該戰役中的指揮日期或戰果。
body.en: The SCC Times article says that under Bose and the Provisional Government of Azad Hind the INA was reorganised as an armed force that fought alongside Japanese forces in the Burma campaign and sought to enter India. Shah Nawaz Khan, formerly of the 14th Punjab Regiment, rose to command the Subhas Regiment and later held a senior staff position. At the Red Fort trial he was charged with waging war against the King-Emperor under Section 121 IPC and separately accused of abetment in the killing of Gunner Mohammad Hussain near Popa, Burma, in March 1945. These are the charges as stated; the source gives no command dates or outcomes for him in the campaign.

heading.zh-Hant: 加爾各答市政與國大黨主席
heading.en: Calcutta Corporation and the Congress presidency

body.zh-Hant: 據孟加拉國家百科，鮑斯1924年被任命為加爾各答市政府的首席行政官；1928年加爾各答國大黨年會上，他擔任國大黨志願軍團的指揮官，並與尼赫魯主張完全獨立，而甘地與莫蒂拉爾·尼赫魯主張自治領地位。他1929年出任全印工會大會主席，次年當選加爾各答市長。1938年他一致當選國大黨主席，次年連任，但因激進立場與黨核心疏離、甘地也反對他，於1939年4月辭去主席職務；日本亞洲歷史資料中心的辭典也寫，他是在甘地的壓力下辭去議長（議長即國大黨主席）。
body.en: According to Banglapedia, Bose was appointed Chief Executive Officer of the Calcutta Corporation in 1924; at the 1928 Calcutta Congress session he commanded the Congress Volunteer Corps and, with Nehru, pushed for complete independence while Gandhi and Motilal Nehru favoured dominion status. He became President of the All India Trade Union Congress in 1929 and Mayor of Calcutta the following year. He was unanimously elected Congress President in 1938 and re-elected the next year, but alienated from the core leadership by his militant stand and opposed by Gandhi, he resigned in April 1939; the JACAR dictionary likewise says he resigned the Congress presidency under Gandhi's pressure.

heading.zh-Hant: 印度國大黨內的激進派領袖
heading.en: Radical leader within the Indian National Congress

body.zh-Hant: 鮑斯1897年1月23日生於孟加拉，是印度國民大會黨自1920年代末起的領導人之一，代表較年輕、較激進的一翼，對抗英國殖民統治。他主張完全脫離英國獨立，與較溫和的黨內同僚意見不合，1939年辭去國大黨主席。其後他組建全印前進集團（Forward Bloc），這是國大黨內的左翼派系。
body.en: Bose was born on 23 January 1897 in Bengal and was one of the leaders of the Indian National Congress from the late 1920s, representing a younger, more militant wing in the struggle against British colonial rule. He advocated complete independence from British rule and disagreed with his more moderate colleagues, resigning the Congress presidency in 1939. He then formed the All India Forward Bloc, a left-wing faction within the Congress.

heading.zh-Hant: 德國與東南亞
heading.en: Germany and the move to Southeast Asia

body.zh-Hant: 二戰期間，鮑斯於1941年逃往柏林，在德國組建一支由印度戰俘構成的印度軍團，也經德國的自由印度電台向印度播送宣傳。他在1943年2月前搭德、日潛艇前往日占東南亞，在新加坡推動「自由印度軍」即印度國民軍。1943年7月8日，印度國民軍一支隊伍在他與日本首相東條英機面前閱兵。
body.en: During the war Bose fled to Berlin in 1941 and in Germany established the Indian Legion, a small force of Indian prisoners of war; he also contributed to the Special Bureau for India, which broadcast propaganda on Azad Hind Radio. By February 1943 he had travelled by German and Japanese submarine to Japanese-occupied Southeast Asia, where in Singapore he promoted a 'Free Indian Army', the Indian National Army. On 8 July 1943 a formation of the INA paraded before Bose and the Japanese Prime Minister Tojo.

heading.zh-Hant: 印度國民軍、臨時政府與逝世
heading.en: The INA, the provisional government and death

body.zh-Hant: 鮑斯成為印度國民軍的指揮官，並設立自由印度臨時政府，獲軸心國承認；1943年10月他在新加坡成立該政府。他說服日方從緬甸入侵印度，印度國民軍作為小部隊與日軍並肩作戰，於1944年的英帕爾戰役中突入印度，但供應線過長、缺乏空中掩護，最終被逐回緬甸。他在1945年8月搭乘的日本飛機於臺灣起飛後墜毀，他因灼傷身亡；丹麥國家百科給的日期是1945年8月18日。
body.en: Bose became commanding officer of the INA and set up a provisional government of free India, which was recognized by the Axis powers; in October 1943 he formed that government in Singapore. He persuaded the Japanese to attempt an invasion of India from Burma, with the INA as a small force alongside the Japanese; it broke into India near Imphal in 1944 (the Battle of Imphal), but supply lines were overextended and there was no air cover, and the INA was driven back through Burma. The Japanese plane he was in crashed after take-off in Taiwan in August 1945 and he died of his burns; the Danish national encyclopedia gives the date as 18 August 1945.

heading.zh-Hant: 官方紀錄中的鮑斯、臨時政府與英帕爾
heading.en: Official records: Bose, the Provisional Government and Imphal

body.zh-Hant: 1941年11月27日，印度事務大臣在下議院答覆稱，傳單使人無疑鮑斯已投向敵方，據報他在羅馬或柏林，但沒有確切消息。據Banglapedia，他搭潛艇於1943年7月2日抵達新加坡；拉什·貝哈里·鮑斯正式把印度國民軍交給他後，他於1943年8月25日成為其總司令，並於10月21日宣布成立自由印度臨時政府（JACAR辭典亦稱他在10月於新加坡樹立臨時政府並成為「首班」）。他1944年1月把國民軍總部遷往仰光，並在緬甸邊境指揮對英軍的作戰；JACAR稱國民軍參加英帕爾戰役、與日軍一同戰敗，他本人於1945年8月18日在台北飛機事故中死亡。英國下議院1945年12月3日的答覆稱，加入或涉入印度國民軍活動者約43,000人，其中只有2萬人是印度陸軍成員。（注意：本檔另一出處〔英國國家檔案館〕寫1943年7月被宣布為領袖，與Banglapedia的8月25日不同。）
body.en: On 27 November 1941 the Secretary of State for India told the Commons that leaflets left no doubt Bose had gone over to the enemy, reportedly in Rome or Berlin. According to Banglapedia he reached Singapore by submarine on 2 July 1943, became Commander-in-Chief of the INA on 25 August after Rash Behari Bose handed it over, and declared the Provisional Government of Azad Hind on 21 October (JACAR says he became its head). INA headquarters moved to Rangoon in January 1944; JACAR says the INA fought at Imphal and was heavily defeated, and that he died in a plane crash at Taipei on 18 August 1945. A Commons answer of 3 December 1945 put those enrolled in or involved with the INA at about 43,000, of whom only 20,000 were Indian Army members.
